placements.title: Deployment pipeline integrity becomes a governed architectural concern

placements.title: Meridian deploys move from implicit trust to verified signed release
placements.theme: A Meridian deployment only proceeds once its release manifest is signed, closing the gap that let unverified artifacts reach staging.
placements.why: All five segments are facets of one theme, not five separate facts: the directive mandating a signed manifest (src-1), the incident that motivated it (src-2, evidence FOR the theme rather than its own leaf per the grain test), and the gate's formalized spec/scope/owner (src-3, src-4, src-5) are all restatements and elaborations of the same directional claim — Meridian deploys now require verified sign-off before they ship. Nothing in the (empty) existing graph holds this theme, so it is minted fresh under the newly-placed Architecture strata rather than left to sprawl as separate leaves for the incident, the scope, and the owner.
